name: Interior, Wayfinding & Delivery Video Briefs
body: # FLUX 3 architecture and mobility prompts Six briefs focused on space, visible routes and clear object handling. Generated visuals cannot certify measurements, accessibility, vehicle safety or actual service availability. ## B01 — A corner without enlargement **Use:** truthful interior-preview concept · **Mode:** image to video **Input:** licensed first frame of the actual room corner **Format:** 16:9, 15 seconds · **Adjust:** pan distance, not architecture. ```text Start exactly from the supplied room photograph. Preserve the wall junction, desk, chair, radiator, window and every visible obstruction. No person enters. 00:00–00:05 — Hold the initial view at a natural eye level. Show stable vertical lines and believable room dimensions. 00:05–00:10 — Pan slowly from desk toward the adjoining visible wall. The desk edge remains in view as a scale reference. Do not move through furniture. 00:10–00:15 — Stop on a balanced corner composition. The same window light falls in the same direction. AUDIO: Quiet interior room tone only. No new street or appliance event. LOCK: Wall positions, desk proportions, furniture count, window height and finish. TEXT: None; add verified dimensions separately if needed. AVOID: stretching the room, removing radiator, extra windows, luxury upgrades, impossible lens expansion, rental promises, branding or watermark. ``` ## B02 — The sign and the decision **Use:** wayfinding design visualization · **Mode:** image to video **Input:** approved first frame of a corridor junction with existing signage **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds · **Adjust:** walking speed after route verification. ```text Use the supplied image of a corridor junction and one consenting visitor. Preserve the corridor layout and existing sign placement. Do not invent or rewrite sign text. 00:00–00:06 — Static wide shot. Visitor stops before the junction and looks at the sign, leaving the walking route clear. 00:06–00:12 — Visitor turns toward the branch already indicated in the approved scene brief, then begins walking at a normal pace. Keep the same bag and clothing. 00:12–00:18 — Camera follows a short distance, stopping before the source-supported space ends. Do not reveal a destination absent from the reference. AUDIO: Footsteps, light bag movement and corridor ambience. No fabricated station announcement. LOCK: Sign, junction, travel direction and visitor identity. TEXT: Preserve existing text where readable; no new overlays. AVOID: unsupported route advice, changing arrows, new doors, teleportation, misleading accessibility claims, extra people or watermark. ``` ## B03 — Park, then unload **Use:** stationary cargo-bike delivery concept · **Mode:** text to video **Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds · **Adjust:** parcel size within the cargo box. ```text Show an adult courier beside a stationary unbranded cargo bicycle on a broad pedestrian forecourt. The bike is already securely parked on its stand. One small cardboard parcel sits in the front cargo box. 00:00–00:06 — Locked side view. Courier checks the bike is steady with one hand on the frame. No traffic or riding. 00:06–00:13 — Courier opens the existing cargo-box lid, lifts the one parcel with both hands and places it on a nearby low bench. 00:13–00:20 — Close the lid, pick up the parcel again and walk slowly toward an already visible doorway. Hold before entering. AUDIO: Latch, cardboard, footsteps and quiet outdoor ambience. No narration or music. LOCK: Wheel count, stand, cargo-box geometry, one parcel and courier clothing. AVOID: moving bike during unloading, changing wheels, oversized load, delivery-time claims, address labels, logos, unsafe road scene or watermark. ``` ## B04 — A parcel changes hands **Use:** last-meter logistics illustration · **Mode:** text to video **Format:** 9:16, 18 seconds · **Adjust:** reception decor, retaining the handoff sequence. ```text At a fictional building reception desk, one courier holds one plain small parcel. A receptionist stands behind a clear counter. No personal information appears. 00:00–00:06 — Medium two-shot. Courier places the parcel on the counter and keeps a hand beside it, not on top of a screen. 00:06–00:12 — Receptionist inspects the blank side, nods and draws the parcel closer. Courier releases it only after the receptionist's hand makes contact. 00:12–00:18 — Receptionist places it in one existing shelf bay. Courier steps back and exits along the visible path. AUDIO: Cardboard on counter, footsteps and quiet reception ambience. No speech or confirmation beep without a device. LOCK: One parcel, same orientation markings, shelf bay and people. AVOID: generated signatures, fake tracking details, duplicate parcels, guaranteed delivery claims, teleporting package, brands, captions or watermark. ``` ## B05 — Furniture, not new walls **Use:** interior layout concept transition · **Mode:** start/end to video **Input:** two approved frames with identical camera and room geometry **Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds · **Adjust:** furniture positions only through the endpoints. ```text Match the first reference frame of a small reading room and finish on the approved second frame. Walls, windows, doors and floor remain identical. Only one lightweight chair and one side table change position. 00:00–00:06 — Hold the opening composition, then an adult enters along the existing clear doorway. 00:06–00:14 — The person lifts the chair and carries it to its end-frame position, then moves the side table separately. Objects have weight and never slide through each other. 00:14–00:20 — Person exits by the same doorway. Camera stays locked; settle exactly into the end-frame furniture arrangement. AUDIO: Footsteps, restrained wood contacts and unchanged room tone. No score. LOCK: Architectural dimensions, furniture geometry, light and one continuous room. AVOID: walls morphing, furniture duplicating, magically moving objects, renovation claims, impossible clearance, extra décor, text, logos or watermark. ``` ## B06 — Waiting behind the line **Use:** calm transit-environment concept · **Mode:** text to video **Format:** 16:9, 15 seconds · **Adjust:** fictional station materials, keeping safe separation. ```text Create a generic modern train platform with a clearly visible edge boundary and a bench well behind it. One adult traveler in a tan jacket stands beside a closed suitcase, also well behind the boundary. No train arrives. 00:00–00:05 — Locked wide view establishes the platform edge, suitcase and traveler with ample space between them and the boundary. 00:05–00:10 — Traveler retracts the suitcase handle and moves it next to the bench, then sits without obstructing the walking path. 00:10–00:15 — Hold the quiet waiting posture. Distant overhead lights remain steady; no schedule board is readable. AUDIO: Soft station ventilation, suitcase wheels and bench contact. No live timetable announcement or approaching train. LOCK: Boundary position, platform geometry, one suitcase and traveler. AVOID: stepping across the edge, train-induced wind, extra luggage, invented service times, unsafe crowding, signs, logos or watermark. ```
description_en: Six spatial video briefs — a room preview that may not enlarge the room, corridor wayfinding, cargo-bike unloading, a last-meter parcel handoff, a furniture-only layout change and a platform safety line.
description_zh: 六条空间类视频简报——不得放大房间的室内预览、走廊导视、货运自行车卸货、最后一米包裹交接、只移动家具的布局变化，以及站台安全线场景。
long_en: The distinguishing constraint here is truthfulness about space. Interior briefs start from a licensed photograph of the actual room and forbid stretching it, removing a radiator, adding windows or applying luxury upgrades; the desk edge must stay in frame as a scale reference. The layout-transition brief is a start/end-frame job where only furniture positions may change between two frames sharing identical camera and room geometry. The transit brief keeps the traveller behind the platform boundary with no readable timetable, and every brief bans invented service times, rental promises, certified measurements, logos and watermarks.
long_zh: 这组简报最鲜明的约束是对空间的诚实。室内类简报要求从已获授权的真实房间照片出发，禁止拉伸空间、移除暖气片、增加窗户或做豪华化升级；书桌边缘必须留在画面中充当比例参照。布局转换那条是首尾帧任务，两帧的机位与房间几何完全相同，中间只允许家具位置变化。交通类简报要求旅客始终停在站台安全线之后，且时刻表不可读；所有简报都禁止编造班次时间、租赁承诺、认证式尺寸标注、商标与水印。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. Image-to-video and start/end-frame briefs need real photographs you have the rights to. The briefs state up front that generated visuals cannot certify measurements, accessibility, vehicle safety or actual service availability — if you use them for property or transit communication, treat the output as an illustration and label it as such. Written and named for FLUX 3, whose availability is staged. The source repo is run by the commercial API reseller bestimage.ai; these prompt files carry no product placement.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。图生视频与首尾帧类简报需要你自备拥有权利的真实照片。简报开头即已声明：生成画面无法证明尺寸、无障碍条件、车辆安全或实际服务可用性——若用于房产或交通类传播，请把生成结果当作示意图并明确标注。以 FLUX 3 命名与撰写，而该模型分阶段开放。来源仓库由商业 API 转售商 bestimage.ai 运营，不过这些提示词文件没有产品植入。
